opportunities.title: EF Hult Prize 2027: Team Registration
opportunities.summary: Global student startup competition. Teams pitch a for-profit business that supports a UN SDG; the winning team receives US$1M in seed funding.
opportunities.description:
The EF Hult Prize is a year-long global competition for student startups. Teams build a for-profit, for-good business idea and compete through qualifying rounds, nationals, a digital incubator and a global accelerator, ending in the Global Finals.

The official site lists the stages as: Qualifiers (September–February), Nationals (April–May), Digital Incubator (June–July), Global Accelerator (August) and Global Finals (September).
opportunities.eligibility:
- Every team member must be enrolled in a degree-seeking programme (undergraduate or graduate) at a university or college
- Teams of 2–4 members
- All members must be at least 18 years old by February 28th, 2027
- The business must be for-profit and directly support at least one UN Sustainable Development Goal
- If your university, region or country hosts a local Hult Prize event, you must register and compete through it
opportunities.benefits:
The winning team receives US$1 million in seed funding (the Hult Prize Foundation takes an equity stake, typically 10%, and the prize is tied to milestones).
Participants also get access to mentorship, educational opportunities, perks, scholarship opportunities, investment connections and a global network. The Global Accelerator is a month of mentorship at Ashridge House, London.
There is no entry fee, but travel, meals and accommodation are the participant's own cost.
opportunities.requirements:
- A team name and contact details for every team member
- Your startup name, country and the SDG you address
- For the qualifying round: a 4-minute pitch video (YouTube link), a pitch deck (PDF) and a startup one-pager (PDF, on Hult Prize's template), all in English
- Proof of student status if requested
opportunities.application_steps:
Form a team of 2–4 eligible students
Develop a for-profit, for-good business idea that tackles a UN SDG
Register your team on the official Hult Prize registration form
Compete through your campus event if your university hosts one, or through the Open Application if not
Submit your pitch video, pitch deck and one-pager
opportunities.deadline_note: No registration deadline published. The official site lists Qualifiers as September–February. Check whether your campus runs its own qualifier with an earlier date.
opportunities.verification_notes: Read hultprize.org /register, /, /competition, /how-it-works, /terms-conditions, /competition/qualifiers on 2026-11-16. The register form is live and states the age cutoff as Feb 28th, 2027 (the 2026-27 cycle). No registration deadline is stated. The terms page still cites a Feb 28, 2025 age date (stale). Re-check by end of Feb 2027.

opportunities.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge 2026/2027 (Nigeria)
opportunities.summary: University teams research a listed company, write an equity research report and pitch it to judges. Winners advance to the sub-regional, regional and global rounds.
opportunities.eligible_summary: University teams of 4 students + faculty adviser
opportunities.description: The CFA Institute Research Challenge is an annual competition in which university teams research a publicly traded company, write a research report and present their analysis to a panel of judges. CFA Society Nigeria runs the Nigerian round and says it is currently taking applications for the 2026/2027 edition. Local winners advance to the sub-regional, regional and global rounds.
opportunities.eligibility:
- Each participating university forms a team of four students (two males, two females)
- Each team is guided by a faculty adviser and an industry mentor
- Check full eligibility with CFA Society Nigeria; the society's page doesn't list individual student requirements
opportunities.benefits: Hands-on mentoring and intensive training in financial analysis and ethics, mentorship from industry experts, BootCamp training, and a pathway to global recognition through the sub-regional, regional and global rounds.
opportunities.requirements:
- A university team of four students (two males, two females)
- A faculty adviser
- Team details for the official registration form
opportunities.application_steps:
Form a team of four students (two males, two females) at your university with a faculty adviser
Submit your team details on CFA Society Nigeria's official form
Attend BootCamp training and research the assigned company
Write the research report and present it to the judges
opportunities.deadline_note: CFA Society Nigeria hasn't published a closing date. Teams register through their university, so contact your department or the society early.
opportunities.verification_notes: Society page on 2026-11-16: 'We are currently taking applications for the 2026/2027 edition.' The 'Submit Your Team Details' button links to the Google Form above. No deadline or prizes are stated. The page footer says (c) 2025.

opportunities.title: Cowrywise Campus Ambassador Programme
opportunities.summary: Represent Cowrywise on your campus, build skills and get access to events, career support, paid internship opportunities and the Cowrywise Ambassadors scholarship track.
opportunities.description: The Cowrywise Ambassadors programme is a community of students who represent Cowrywise, the Nigerian savings and investment app, on their campuses. The official registration form is live.
opportunities.eligibility:
Cowrywise says ambassadors should be:
- A creative innovator
- A passionate learner
- An effective communicator
- A collaborative team player
- Growth-driven
The registration form covers students of federal, state and private tertiary institutions across Nigeria.
opportunities.benefits: Per Cowrywise: access to Cowrywise events, relevant skills, career support, a certificate of participation, Cowrywise-branded merchandise, entrepreneurial support, a community, paid internship opportunities and scholarship opportunities.
opportunities.requirements: Your name, email, phone number, level, faculty, department and school.
opportunities.application_steps:
Open the official Cowrywise Ambassadors registration form
Fill in your details, level, faculty, department and school
Submit the form and watch your email for next steps
opportunities.deadline_note: Cowrywise doesn't publish a closing date for ambassador registration.
opportunities.verification_notes: Read ambassadors.cowrywise.com on 2026-11-16. The 'Register here' / 'Become an ambassador' buttons go to a live /register form. No open/closed wording and no deadline are shown. The SCHOLARSHIP shows 'Join waitlist', so it is a separate draft and not presented as open here.

opportunities.title: ALAT Campus Ambassadors
opportunities.summary: Join ALAT's student-led community on Nigerian campuses that helps students learn about digital banking.
opportunities.description: ALAT Campus Ambassadors is ALAT by Wema's student-led community on Nigerian campuses that helps students learn about digital banking ("Innovate. Impact. Earn."). The official registration form on alat.ng is live.
opportunities.eligibility:
- Applicants must be 18 or older (stated on the official form)
- The programme is for students on Nigerian campuses
ALAT's page doesn't list other criteria.
opportunities.benefits: Per ALAT: learning resources, career opportunities and a strong network.
opportunities.requirements: Your basic information (including a WhatsApp-enabled +234 phone number and date of birth), school details, your reach and influence on campus, and your motivation.
opportunities.application_steps:
Open the official ALAT Campus Ambassadors page and tap "Register Here"
Complete the four sections: Basic Information, School Details, Reach & Influence, Motivation & Execution
Submit and watch your email/WhatsApp for next steps
opportunities.deadline_note: ALAT doesn't publish a closing date.
opportunities.verification_notes: Read alat.ng/alat-campus-ambassadors on 2026-11-16: live 'Register Here' four-step form, '18+'. No deadline. Benefits such as 'financial rewards' and 'internships' appear only in a May 2026 MSME Africa article and are deliberately not listed.

opportunities.title: CFA Society Nigeria Portfolio Management Challenge
opportunities.summary: Simulated investment challenge for undergraduates, with team and individual tracks.
opportunities.eligibility:
- Undergraduate students only (university, polytechnic and other tertiary institutions)
- Team Track: 10 students per team; investment clubs may register up to two teams; universities without an endorsed investment club may register one team
- Individual Track: open to all undergraduates
opportunities.benefits: Prizes and national recognition (amounts not stated), leaderboard recognition. It's a simulation, so no real money is invested.
opportunities.application_steps:
Register for the challenge
Receive onboarding and platform access
Receive your investment scenario
Attend the official onboarding session
Build and manage your portfolio and compete in your category
opportunities.verification_notes: DRAFT, not verified as open. On 2026-11-16 the page had a 'Register Now' form but stated no edition year, open status or deadline. Confirm the current edition with CFA Society Nigeria before verifying.

opportunities.title: Cowrywise Ambassadors Scholarship
opportunities.summary: ₦200k awarded yearly to each winner, plus mentorship and community, for Cowrywise ambassadors in Nigerian tertiary institutions.

- Full-time undergraduates in any course of study
- Committed to leadership, personal growth and academic excellence
- Willing to be a Cowrywise Ambassador
